method: Direct HTTPS GET of the original draft links, first 1024 bytes, followed by web-reader checks and replacement with accessible arXiv landing-page routes where necessary.

links.web_reader_result: Exact version landing page opened successfully; author/title and v2 July 28, 2011 verified. Full PDF read through https://arxiv.org/pdf/1005.3611, whose latest version is v2.

Canonical landing page opened successfully and identifies latest v2 November 30, 2017. Full PDF read through https://arxiv.org/pdf/1711.06928. Exact-version PDF and abstract routes had tool transport failures.
Same exact URL opened successfully as the 23-page full author manuscript despite direct GET 406.

links.content_verification: Full article HTML and both theorem equation images were separately retrieved and read; sample-link check followed a cookie-related redirect.

summary: All ten current draft bibliography targets have verified accessible routes. Seven original direct requests returned 200; three arXiv requests returned 406. Two draft links were replaced by verified landing-page routes; the third exact PDF works in the web reader.
